name: ClawFence
description: Intent firewall: every tool call is checked against the task's scope. Expected actions run; out-of-scope actions are blocked; only ambiguous actions reach a human, on a physical arbiter.

cliCommands.name: clawfence
cliCommands.description: Inspect and control the ClawFence intent firewall

mode.description: observe logs verdicts only; enforce blocks and escalates.

workspaceOnlyReads.description: When true, reads outside the task scope are escalated instead of allowed.

semantic.description: Use the configured decision model for ambiguous actions when available.

escalation.description: queue: block + physical/web arbiter grant; native: OpenClaw approval card; off: block only.

queueDir.description: Directory for pending requests and grants. Empty uses <stateDir>/clawfence.

escalation.label: Escalation
escalation.help: How ambiguous actions reach a human.
